# Master’s Year 1 University Management and Information Technology

The Master’s in University Management and Information Technology (MUTI) enables students to acquire cross-disciplinary and international skills in order to understand new models of governance and financing for educational and research institutions.

Specialized and internationally focused, this program is primarily designed to train users in the various professions offered by higher education institutions and public operators.

![MOMA](https://www.montpellier-management.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Group-11.svg)

**Why choose Montpellier Management?**

* A wide range of training courses, with around fifty courses ranging from license to doctorate and leading to state diplomas.
* Student support systems, including tutoring sessions, tutorials and access to online resources.
* Dynamic professional integration thanks to multiple initiatives: expert interventions, internships, work-study programs, ResUM network, etc.
* Research of excellence focused on businesses: 90 teacher-researchers, 5 research teams and 11 chairs.
* A strong international dimension with more than 65 destinations spread across more than 25 countries.

## Who is this for?

The master’s degree MUTI is ideal for people who want to specialize in university management and information technology.

This program provides students with key skills in higher education management, digital transformation and information systems management. It prepares future professionals to support the evolution of university organizations by integrating technological and strategic challenges.

## Application requirements

The Master 1 University Management and Information Technology is one of the master’s degrees in the field of Public Management. Students can enroll in this program in the first year (M1). [Visit the IAE Montpellier website for the Master 2 program.](https://iae.umontpellier.fr/formation/master-2-management-des-universites-et-technologies-de-linformation/)

The Master 1 is open to students with a three-year degree in management, economics, etc. (bachelor’s degree, BUT, business school or equivalent) validated by the completion of 180 ECTS credits.

Foreign students who are not members of the European Union and do not have a French degree must first submit an application to [CAMPUS France](https://www.campusfrance.org/fr). Applications will only be reviewed once this formality has been completed.

If you are enrolled in continuing education, please visit [this page](https://sfc.edu.umontpellier.fr/).

## Duration and rythm

The master’s program lasts two years, from M1 to M2.

## Objectives

The main objectives of this program are to provide advanced managerial knowledge that can be applied in various private and public sectors.

Students will receive comprehensive training as public managers and experts in setting up European projects.

Managerial, administrative and political approaches are addressed from an organizational and functional perspective (management, law, finance, HR, international affairs, innovation, project management).

The entire curriculum allows students to develop strategic organizational and environmental thinking from a public/private perspective and to master project management tools adapted to public performance.

It is possible to continue on to a Master’s 2 program in Canada with a double degree by obtaining a Master’s in Public Management and Local Development (University of Sherbrooke).

**SEMESTRE 2 (30 ECTS)**

**UE5 – Management et performance (9,5 ECTS)**

* Management des collectivités territoriales (3,5 ECTS)
* Gestion des ressources humaines (2 ECTS)
* Gestion de l’achat public (2 ECTS)
* Marketing territorial (2 ECTS)

**UE6 – Conception, pilotage et développement (12,5 ECTS)**

The University of Montpellier is one of France's oldest **public research** universities. It was **established in** 1220 in Montpellier, France. The University was formerly split into three universities and old schools, which later combined to form a separate higher educational institute. The University comprises over **50,000 students** and offers **657** national and international **diplomas** in various fields. It is currently **ranked 401-450** in the QS world ranking of top universities.

The [University of Montpellier](https://www.umontpellier.fr/en/) has expanded to **17 faculties, 73 research centers, and 9 doctoral schools.** The **top courses** offered at the University include business studies, engineering, and science and technology. Most courses at the University of Montpellier are taught in French, but some **English-taught courses** are also available. The Bachelor's **course duration** is 3 years, the Master's 1-2 years, and the PhD 3-6 years. **Application fees** for some selected programs are also applicable. Some programs may also require an **IELTS score** of 5.5, but you can study based on a language proficiency certificate.

The **average tuition fee** for Bachelor's programs at the University of Montpellier is 170 euros, for Master's programs 243 euros, and for PhD programs 380 euros per academic year. The **minimum qualification required** to study at this University is a high school diploma. Government and merit-based **scholarships** are available for studying at Montpellier University. NO specific **admission tests are** required for most programs at the University of Montpellier.

## Why Study at the University of Montpellier

The University of Montpellier is one of the top universities in France, offering the following benefits for international students:

* The University of Montpellier is **world-renowned** for its **top** business, law, medicine, science, and technology courses. The academic excellence in these courses attracts thousands of international students each year, and the French Ministry of Education widely recognizes these academic programs.
* It has a global **network of international communities** across the top higher educational institutions in the world, which provides peer support, employment opportunities, and international networking opportunities for students.
* The average **tuition** for Bachelor's, master's, and PhD programs at the University of Montpellier is quite **affordable**. You can easily support your studies with an annual budget of 200-500 euros.
* You are rewarded with government and merit-based **scholarships** at the University and other **study grants** to continue your studies and support your living expenses.
* You can **explore French culture** and tradition by living in France's vibrant and beautiful city, Montpellier.
* Montpellier is in an **ideal location in France**, connecting Marseilles, Nice, and Cannes. You can easily travel across these cities and learn more about France.
* Students will have an opportunity to **learn the French language** at the University through language training courses in France. It is a valuable skill because French is the second most learned language in the world. You will have better employment and part-time working opportunities if you know French.
* The French are known for their **intellectual debates and friendly nature**, so the international students will enjoy collaborating with them.
* International students can **work** up to **964 hours per year** in different sectors like restaurants, hotels, and other services.

## Scholarship Types

### 1. Government Scholarship

The following government scholarship applies to the course programs taught at Montpellier University.

#### 1. Eiffel Scholarship Program of Excellence

It is a [French government scholarship](https://www.campusfrance.org/en/france-excellence-eiffel-scholarship-program) supported by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs. International students at the University of Montpellier can apply for this Scholarship, which will prepare future decision-makers to represent France and French institutions worldwide.

##### **Benefits of the Scholarship**

* Accommodation
* Travel expenses
* Living expenses
* Other expenses covered
* Health and medical insurance

##### **Programs available for the Scholarship**

* Master studies
* Doctorate Research Programs

##### **Eligibility Criteria for the Scholarship**

* Students studying in a master's program
* Students in Doctorate Programs
* Regularly conducting studies at the University of Montpellier
* Engineering programs
* Demonstrate English language proficiency

##### **Scholarship Amount**

* 1181 euros for Master's degree programs
* 1800 euros for PhD degree programs

##### **How to Apply for the Scholarship**

* Log into the campus France online portal.
* Choose the University of Montpellier for the Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
* Choose your program of interest
* Provide necessary information
* Submit your application

##### **Deadline for the Scholarship**

* The deadline for the 2025 intakes for this Scholarship is January 8, 2025.



### 2. Merit-based Scholarship

There are the following merit-based scholarships available at the University of Montpellier:

* IDIL Scholarship - University of Montpellier
* Interdisciplinary Master's scholarships
* Erasmus + Scholarships
* MBS Scholarships
* Crous Grants
* International Mobility Scholarships

#### 1. IDIL Scholarship - University of Montpellier

This is a merit-based scholarship offered by Montpellier University for international students in Master's programs taught in English. There are 2 types of scholarships for this grant: study and transport scholarships.

##### **Benefits of the Scholarship**

For the First Year (M1) total of 3000 euros

* 600 euros in August
* 600 euros per month between September and December

**For the 2nd year (M2) total of 2400 euros**

* 600 euros per month from September to December
* 600 euros in case of a single registration in M2

##### **Duration of the Scholarship**

* 2 Years

##### **Eligibility Criteria for the Scholarship**

* Must be an International citizen not having French citizenship
* Not studied in French institutions for the last 2 years
* B-2 Level of English language proficiency
* Enrolled in Master's programs at the University
* Excellent academic records

##### **Level of Study for the Scholarship**

* Masters programs taught in English

##### **Language Requirements for the Scholarship**

* B-2 Level of language proficiency in English

##### **Programs Available for the Scholarship**

* Agronomy
* Law
* Chemistry
* Biology
* Engineering
* Economics: Politics
* Physical sciences
* Finances

* The University automatically considers scholarship applicants based on merit.

#### 2. Interdisciplinary Master's scholarships

These scholarships in the biology master's research program at the University of Montpellier aim to provide financial grants for health research.

##### **Research areas for the Scholarship**

* Technologies for Health Bioengineering
* Neurosciences
* Genetics-Epigenetics
* Infectiology-Immunology
* Quantitative Biology
* Cancerology
* Experimental and regenerative Medicines

##### **Eligibility Criteria for the Scholarship**

* Students must pursue an interdisciplinary research project.
* It should be from 7 research areas of the biology given above.
* Research must be conducted at the University of Montpellier.

##### **Selection Criteria**

* Student work program

* Student training in Interdisciplinary projects

##### **Scholarship Amount**

* 20 grants of 100,000 euros in total

##### **Deadline for the Scholarship**

* The deadline for this Scholarship was June 7, 2024. It will be available in April 2025.

## Eligibility Criteria

The specific eligibility criteria for studying at Montpellier University differ with the course. However, a general criteria is hereby given:

* You should be registered in your home university or school
* High school diploma
* International students must have a bachelor's degree, as this university has few bachelor's programs.
* Language proficiency of B-2 Level or [IELTS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_English_Language_Testing_System) score of 5.5-6 for some programs
* Educational contract with the university professors
* Proof of funds to support travel and accommodation costs in the University

Montpellier University's top English courses can be subcategorized into bachelor's, master's, and PhD programs.

### Bachelors Courses

* Bachelor of International Business Administration (BBA) program at Montpellier Business School (MBS)

### Masters Courses

* Global Challenges for Sustainable Development
* Finance
* Marketing
* Business & Strategy and Management
* Biological and Food Engineering (GBA department)
* Computer Science and Management (IG department)
* Business & Strategy and Management
* Microelectronics and Automation (MEA department)

### PhD Curses

* Territories, Time, Societies, and Development (TTSD)
* Law and Political Science
* Information Structures Systems (I2S)
* Montpellier Economics and Management (EDEG)
* GAIA (Biodiversity, Agriculture, Food, Environment, Land, Water)
* Human Movement Sciences
* Ballard Chemical Sciences (SCB)
* Languages, Literature, Cultures, and Civilizations (LLCC)
* Chemical and Biological Sciences for Health (CBS2)

## How to Apply for University of Montpellier

Follow the step-by-step approach to apply for Montpellier University.

* Choose your program of interest.
* Check for the eligibility of the program from the University's official website.
* Go to the university's online portal
* Click on the Apply Now button
* Fill out the application form by giving the correct information
* Attach all the required documents
* Take the MBS logical reasoning test if you apply for business studies or a master's program at the MBS School of Business.
* If you do not have proficiency tests for English, such as IELTS or TOEFL, you can also take the MBS English test for free.
* Pay the application fee, if applicable, for your program
* Submit the application form
* Wait for a call from the University

## How to Enroll in the University of Montpellier

The enrollment process is simple

* Get a pre-enrollment form.
* Verify from the French embassy or consulate in your home country and get a study visa for France.
* Provide a certificate of civil liability
* Book your accommodation
* Book an appointment at the admission desk of Montpellier University



## FAQs

### Q1) How much does Montpellier University cost for international students?

**Answer:** Montpellier University is one of the most affordable universities in France in terms of tuition fees. The average annual tuition fee for a bachelor's program is 170 euros, for a master's degree 243 euros, and for a PhD degree 380 euros. Students can easily afford these reasonable prices to study in France.

### Q2) What is the University of Montpellier ranked in the world?

**Answer:** The University of Montpellier ranked 448 in 2025 according to the QS World University Ranking, 194 according to US news and world reports, 101-200 according to Times Higher Education, and top 200 in Shanghai rankings.

### Q3) Does the University of Montpellier teach in English?

**Answer:** Yes, the University of Montpellier teaches a few English programs, most of which are in French. Only one Bachelor's program is taught in English, the Bachelor of International Business Administration (BBA) program at Montpellier Business School (MBS). The master's programs that are taught in English include Global Challenges for Sustainable Development Finance, Marketing, Business & Strategy and Management, Biological and Food Engineering, Computer Science and Management, Business & Strategy and Management, Microelectronics and Automation, Water Science, and Materials Science.

### Q4) What are the English requirements for the University of Montpellier?

**Answer:** The language proficiency requirements for studying at the University of Montpellier are a minimum B-2 English language proficiency level. Some programs, like International Business Administration, may require an IELTS score of 5.5–6. You can also take a MBS language test for free if you do not have language proficiency certifications.

### Q5) What is the application deadline for the University of Montpellier in 2025?

**Answer:** The application deadline for the University of Montpellier is January 8, 2025. The intakes start in October 2024.

## You are an exchange student pursuing a degree

Before making arrangements for your arrival in France, please contact the Campus France office in your home country. If your country is on the Campus France list, the procedure requires that applications be submitted to Campus France before you can apply for admission to the University of Montpellier. Here you will find the “Study in France” procedure for applying based on your level of study.

Un diplôme français est une valeur ajoutée dans un parcours universitaire ; il est souvent recherché par les grandes entreprises nationales et internationales installées au Vietnam. Ce n’est cependant pas la seule raison de choisir une formation française.
Choisir une éducation internationale d’excellence… Étudier dans une université vietnamienne de qualité … tout en restant au Vietnam Faciliter la poursuite d’études en France La France investit chaque année environ 26,6 milliards d’euros dans l’enseignement supérieur, un investissement au service de la qualité des enseignements, mais aussi de la recherche. En effet, avec 15 médailles Fields et 71 prix Nobel, la France est un des pays les plus décorés au monde. Suivre une formation délocalisée, c’est donc avoir accès aux meilleurs professeurs-cher-cheurs et à des formations sans cesse actualisées. Toutes les formations délocalisées sont réalisées en partenariat avec de grandes universités vietnamiennes, pour la plupart appartenant au réseau de l’Université nationale. Ces partenariats font toute la richesse de la formation, en alliant des professeurs d’uni-versités vietnamiennes réputées, qui connaissent bien les besoins locaux, aux professeurs venus de France. Certaines formations délivrent d’ailleurs un double diplôme.
Une formation délocalisée permet d’acquérir de solides connaissances, prodiguées par des profes-seurs et experts internationaux, tout en restant au Vietnam. Ces formations ont donc l’avantage d’être plus accessibles. En effet, plusieurs formations au niveau Master sont dispensées le soir et le week-end, ce qui permet aux actifs de poursuivre leurs études tout en continuant à travailler en journée. Suivre des études dans son propre pays permet également d’éviter les frais liés à une expatriation.
La plupart des formations proposent des passerelles pour étudier en France, que ce soit au niveau Master après une Licence, en deuxième année de Master ou bien en Doctorat. Choisir une formation délocalisée, c’est donc aussi faciliter la poursuite des études en France, tout en ayant les connaissances, compétences et outils méthodologiques pour répondre aux exigences des formations choisies.
